selectionPolicy: Prefer complete, internally coherent recipe sources before image coverage.
Publish one whole source; do not combine recipe content or images across sources.
At least one source-matched mapped step image is required; a hero alone does not satisfy it.

sources.recipeAssessment: Complete and internally coherent; includes ragu ingredients and instructions, bechamel, pasta preparation, layering and baking.
sources.mediaAssessment: Page exposes a finished-dish hero image; no step image is present/mapped to any of its nine method steps.

sources.recipeAssessment: Detailed assembly recipe with process collages, but it requires 1.5 L warm ragu selected from separate recipes and does not itself give that ragu recipe; therefore not a complete single-source recipe for this batch.
sources.mediaAssessment: Several process images exist, but they cannot be cross-used for the complete BBC recipe.

finalDisposition.reason: No candidate simultaneously meets the whole-source completeness rule and the minimum mapped-step-image rule. BBC meets recipe completeness but has no mapped step image; Serious Eats has images but delegates the core ragu component to other recipes. Do not fabricate or cross-source images; leave existing recipe untouched and skip this recipe.
